description: This file defines a custom exception class 'UndoLastTrancheDisbursementException' extending a platform domain rule exception, used in the context of loan disbursement operations within the Fineract project.

classes.name: UndoLastTrancheDisbursementException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that undoing the last tranche disbursement is not allowed after certain conditions like repayments or waivers.

methods.name: UndoLastTrancheDisbursementException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific error code and message, including optional default user message arguments.
